name: MAE OKAFOR
title: THE SCOREKEEPER
story: MAE HAS KEPT THE LEAGUE CARD FOR SIX SEASONS. CLIPBOARD, TWO PENCILS, ONE SPARE. SHE KNOWS EVERYONE'S HANDICAP AND, QUIETLY, EVERYONE'S EXCUSES.
THIS SEASON SHE HANDED THE CLIPBOARD TO THE NEW GUY. SHE WANTS TO FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENS WHEN SHE PLAYS FOR HERSELF INSTEAD OF COUNTING FOR EVERYONE ELSE.
AT THE FINALE SHE SINKS THE LAST PUTT, WALKS TO THE BOARD AND WRITES HER OWN NAME AT THE TOP. NEATLY. IN PEN.

name: DEZ PRUITT
title: THE BOMBER
story: DEZ THROWS FAR. FARTHER THAN THE FAIRWAY, SOMETIMES FARTHER THAN THE PARK. THE GROUNDSKEEPER HAS A BOX OF HIS DISCS IN THE SHED.
HE HAS NEVER WON A LEAGUE NIGHT. HIS DRIVES ARE LEGEND; HIS PUTTING IS A RUMOUR. THIS YEAR HE IS PRACTISING TEN-FOOTERS IN HIS DRIVEWAY.
AT THE FINALE HE LAYS UP ON THE LAST HOLE. NOBODY BELIEVES IT. HE TAPS IN FOR PAR AND THE WHOLE CARD CHEERS LIKE HE ACED IT.

name: JUNE LINDQVIST
title: THE WEATHER WATCHER
story: JUNE CARRIES A POCKET ANEMOMETER AND A NOTEBOOK OF EVERY GUST ON EVERY HOLE SINCE SHE MOVED TO TOWN. SHE THROWS LEFTY AND DOES NOT APOLOGISE FOR IT.
SHE LEARNED TO READ THE TREETOPS FROM HER GRANDMOTHER, WHO SAILED. THE WIND IS NOT YOUR ENEMY, SHE SAYS. IT IS JUST NOT YOUR FRIEND YET.
ON THE STORMIEST FINALE IN LEAGUE HISTORY, EVERYONE ELSE PUTS AWAY THEIR DRIVERS. JUNE SMILES AND THROWS INTO IT.

name: HAL BRISCOE
title: THE FOUNDER

lock.text: WIN THE LANTERN CUP OR EARN 600 CRED

story: HAL HUNG THE FIRST STRING OF LANTERNS IN THE PARK THIRTY YEARS AGO, SO FOUR FRIENDS COULD FINISH A ROUND AFTER WORK. THAT WAS THE FIRST LEAGUE NIGHT.
HIS ARM IS NOT WHAT IT WAS. HIS PUTTER IS EXACTLY WHAT IT WAS. HE STILL BRINGS THE THERMOS AND STILL READS THE RULES OUT LOUD AT THE FIRST TEE.
THIS IS HIS LAST SEASON ON THE CARD. HE DOES NOT WANT A SPEECH. HE WANTS ONE MORE CLEAN ROUND UNDER THE LANTERNS, AND MAYBE THE CUP.
